name: stage_1_baseline_whr_off
description: Identical stage 1 to picrawler_whr_jitter_probe.json (Joseph hand-tuned params, walk_hit_rate=0) so the settled stage-2 windows are comparable across arms. Advance ~80s.

name: stage_2_whr_on_005_total_speed
description: DIRECTION-FREE control for the whr softening mechanism. walk_hit_rate=0.05 identical to the to_target treatment, but walk_reward_mode=total_speed rewards ANY sustained movement (consistent egocentric credit: 'move' is always the rewarded action). target_mode stays random_pyramid so the target_compass percept is identical across arms — only the reward MAPPING differs. Discriminates: if |knee_cmd| softens here like to_target -> generic reward-stream credit dilution; if it stays firm -> the softening is directional credit inconsistency (heading drift makes 'approach' an inconsistent egocentric action).
